description: Shading/normals artefacts in Blender 2.9 after an AMD driver update (fixed in 2.91.2); occurs without High Quality Normals in Eevee.
expected_report: In the Blender viewport a textured model renders with broken normals: visible faceted or corrupted shading artefacts that change as the view moves. Expected: correct smooth shading. Cause was AMD drivers; workaround High Quality Normals or older drivers.
difficulty: 3D viewport artefacts, dark Blender UI with small text, no narration, nothing points at the bug.
